description.value: Dank Mart is a specialty exotic snack shop in Downtown Vancouver stocking hard-to-find candy, chips, chocolate, drinks, and novelty food items from around the world. It operates both a physical retail location and an online store with international shipping. The contact page describes it as a 'Rare Snack Shop Downtown Vancouver,' suggesting a curated selection that goes well beyond a standard corner store.
